run_maskformer_on_images: run maskformer segmentation on input images using the demo CLI with --input flag
run_maskformer_on_webcam: run maskformer segmentation on live webcam feed using the demo CLI with --webcam flag
run_maskformer_on_video: run maskformer segmentation on a video file using the demo CLI with --video-input flag
setup_maskformer_config: setup a detectron2 config with maskformer options using setup_cfg from a YAML config file
test_opencv_video_format: test if an OpenCV video codec and file extension combination is supported on the system
